summary: Event streams can replace rulebook sources in an activation: each stream replaces a source only once, mapping applies only to that activation, and it breaks if the rulebook changes (a restart after modification fails). Create the activation under Rulebook Activations and pick a rulebook to enable the Event streams gear.
questions: How do I attach an event stream to a rulebook activation?
Why did my activation fail after I changed the rulebook?
Can one event stream replace several sources?
Does source mapping apply to all activations of a rulebook?
